families.workflow: Ordered shortlist of literature or measurement decisions for the evidence pipeline.
families.decisionContext: Non-sensitive engineering decisions about which already-authorized evidence source, measurement method, or evidence-processing step should be evaluated next. Exclude gait sessions, video, keypoints, biometrics, athlete/client material, and customer data.
families.naturalTrigger: A participant naturally proposes or reviews alternatives for an evidence-pipeline decision against a shared immutable engineering base; do not create decisions or tasks to generate observations.

families.workflow: Ordered non-clinical architecture or Spec Kit option list.
families.decisionContext: Non-clinical engineering choices in architecture, specifications, or Spec Kit artifacts, with source files selected individually after review. Exclude patient records, PA-NNNN material, audio, transcripts, clinical drafts, review/audit events, production traces, and customer data.
families.naturalTrigger: A participant naturally proposes or reviews alternatives during ordinary non-clinical architecture/specification work against one shared immutable engineering base; do not manufacture options or tasks to increase counts.

families.workflow: Natural design decisions about public library or CLI interfaces in existing engineering work.
families.decisionContext: Ordinary engineering decisions about API shape, CLI behavior, compatibility, or error handling, scoped to individually reviewed public source/specification files. This is a proposed third-repository workflow family, not an authorized source feed.
families.naturalTrigger: A real contributor independently proposes alternatives during an already-occurring interface design/review decision against a shared immutable base. No issue, task, branch, or decision may be created solely to produce study observations.

families.workflow: Natural engineering decisions about validation methods for an existing code change.
families.decisionContext: Ordinary decisions about which already-applicable structural, behavioral, or negative-control checks should be run for existing changes. Exclude secrets, credentials, private payloads, user data, and generated test workloads. Distinctness from other Agent Braid workflows is unreviewed.
families.naturalTrigger: Contributors naturally compare validation approaches while reviewing an existing change against a shared immutable base. No checks, changes, or tasks may be manufactured to create candidate pairs.

families.workflow: Natural engineering decisions about evidence completeness and release-readiness findings for an existing change.
families.decisionContext: Ordinary review decisions about whether existing engineering evidence supports a bounded readiness finding or requires follow-up. Exclude access-bearing configuration, credentials, private user data, and any decision to grant release or execution authority.
families.naturalTrigger: A contributor naturally reviews evidence for an already-existing change and independently proposes how to resolve an evidence gap against one shared immutable base; no release scenario or task is manufactured for collection.
